growth_drivers: Proposed acquisition of 100% of the outstanding share capital of Nagarro SE, a global digital engineering and IT consulting company headquartered in Munich, Germany.
Acquisition of the business of Concise Systems OÜ through a Business Purchase Agreement by Persistent Systems Estonia OÜ.
Approval for availing long term Debt Financing by way of ECB, NCDs, and other similar instruments not exceeding USD 1,250 million.
Approval for raising funds through Foreign Currency Convertible Bonds (FCCB), Preferential Issue, or QIP not exceeding USD 450 million.
risks_and_challenges: Exposure to foreign exchange fluctuations and hedging instrument impacts.
Potential debt and interest burdens associated with bridge financing facilities (EUR 1,400 million) and corporate guarantees for the Nagarro SE acquisition.
Regulatory advisory, due diligence, valuation, and other transaction-related costs impacting other expenses.
business_segments: Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI): Provides specialized digital engineering, technology, and consulting services tailored for banking, financial services, and insurance institutions.
Healthcare & Life Sciences: Delivers technology solutions, software product engineering, and digital transformation services for healthcare providers, medical technology, and life sciences companies.
Software, Hi-Tech and Emerging Industries: Focuses on product engineering, platform development, and advanced digital solutions for software companies, hi-tech enterprises, and emerging sectors.
